covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Monday, August 24, 2026, through before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, August 25, 2026. No liquid, well-confirmed Monday after-close name qualified; all ranked names report Tuesday pre-market.
market_context_summary: U.S. stocks were mixed near records, with technology weaker and long-term yields elevated. Tuesday consumer-confidence and housing data add macro sensitivity, while later-week PCE and major technology earnings can affect risk appetite.

universe_exclusions.reason: Official IR confirmed August 26, outside the window.

top_setups.note: No company had a negative consensus score; MZTI and BNS were Neutral / No Edge.

consensus_method.disparity_formula: Average of direction-score range normalized to the -100..100 scale and reversal-risk range normalized to 0..100, expressed on 0..100.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Core DICK'S comps; Foot Locker segment profit
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Integration costs and Q2 margin trough
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A de-risked share price, resilient core comps, and early Foot Locker stabilization create modest relief upside if margin and guidance hold.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $3.76-$3.78 adjusted EPS and $5.64-$5.65B revenue; Street core comparable-sales expectation is about 4.1%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Core comps exceed 5%, Foot Locker improves, and consolidated profit guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Foot Locker margins, store investments, tariffs, or integration costs overwhelm a solid core quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Monthly options implied move was about 11.9%, not a pure event measure; shares fell roughly 20% over three months and short interest was cited near 8.4%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Oppenheimer expected at least an in-line quarter, with $3.79 EPS and 3%-5% core comps; the low share price reduces the bar but positive guidance is still needed.

ranked_companies.timing: Results about 5:30 a.m. ET; call 7:15 a.m. ET on 2026-08-25
ranked_companies.expected_driver: U.S. P&C credit-loss provisions and NIM
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Fee growth and better credit comparisons support a mild positive bias, but the strong Q2 and bank rerating leave limited asymmetry.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public previews center near C$3.74 adjusted EPS, versus C$3.67 in Q2; ADR-calendar EPS is about US$2.69.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: U.S. impaired provisions fall, NIM holds or expands, and CET1 stabilizes.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. commercial or consumer credit costs rise while core NII weakens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options implied about a ±4.8% move, above the 10-year average peak earnings move of ±3.4%.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Estimates rose after a strong Q2; the published EPS bar is constructive and buy-side expectations may be firmer.

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. market open; call 8:15 a.m. ET on 2026-08-25
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Canadian Banking NIM/PTPP growth versus impaired PCL
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Margin and Canadian Banking momentum are good, but the run-up and elevated impaired provisions leave the immediate reaction balanced.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: ADR EPS consensus is roughly US$1.49-$1.53; Q2 adjusted EPS was C$2.02 and adjusted ROE 13.2%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Canadian NIM expands, impaired provisions improve, and management reinforces the 14%+ FY27 ROE path.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Impaired PCL rises or management softens its credit and ROE outlook despite a headline beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about a ±4.6%-4.9% move; shares gained roughly 11% over three months into the report.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Four consecutive EPS beats and improved profitability create a higher whisper bar.

ranked_companies.timing: Before U.S. market open on 2026-08-25 per FactSet/TradingView and TipRanks; IR events page lacked an upcoming event
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Organic Retail volume and gross margin including Bachan's
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Acquisition masks core weakness; integration costs
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Bachan's and a depressed valuation allow relief, but weak organic Retail trends and acquisition costs prevent a dependable direction call.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: FactSet consensus is about $1.40 EPS and $478.95M revenue; another source shows $1.42 and $486.5M.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Organic Retail stabilizes, Bachan's starts cleanly, and gross margin expands.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Core volume stays negative while acquisition SG&A and interest dilute EPS.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No dependable event-implied move was available; the stock had fallen about 30% in 2026 and coverage/liquidity are limited.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: EPS estimates softened slightly and the prior quarter missed both EPS and revenue expectations.
